plugins.name: brand-creative
plugins.description: Complete brand practice in one install — setup interview, brand-voice lifecycle, and brand-guide visual identity. Writes to the instance brand/ directory when bound; standalone Try tier uses docs/brand/.

plugins.name: architecture
plugins.description: Architecture practice in one install — setup interview, solution design (arc42-lite), and ADRs. Writes to docs/architecture/. Companion to engineering for work-item tdd and implementation.

plugins.name: engineering
plugins.description: Complete engineering practice in one install — setup interview, technical design (tdd), implementation, code review, QA, and platform operations. Five personas (Frontend Engineer through WebOps), one owned skill library. Reads brand-guide from resolved brand path; invokes architecture for solution/ADRs and product-management for planning cadence.

plugins.name: ralph-loop
plugins.description: Self-referential delivery loop — seed with ralph-loop-setup, run with ralph-loop. Ships ad-hoc and custom presets; engineering contributes the engineering-delivery preset. Includes Claude Code and Cursor stop hooks.

plugins.name: product-management
plugins.description: Complete product management practice in one install — setup interview, product strategy and PRDs, roadmap, feature specs, research, metrics, stakeholder updates, tasks/backlog decomposition, sprint planning and retro, and epic validation. Personas: Product Manager and Delivery Lead. One owned skill library.

plugins.name: content-marketing
plugins.description: Complete content practice in one install — setup interview, editorial calendar, social curation, media analysis, and CMS seed drafting. Two personas (Content Strategist, Content Writer), one owned skill library. Reads brand voice from resolved brand path; invokes product-management for tasks and research synthesis.

plugins.name: design
plugins.description: Design practice in one install — setup interview, wireframes, live-browser UX design review, and UX design fix. Writes to the instance design/ directory when bound; standalone Try tier uses docs/design/. Bundles Figma and Playwright.

plugins.name: search-optimisation
plugins.description: Complete search and technical SEO practice in one install — setup interview, keyword research, technical audits, and content SEO review. One persona (SEO Specialist), one owned skill library. Invokes product-management for competitive brief.

plugins.name: skills-index
plugins.description: Install-aware skill router — find the right skill among installed plugins, or offer marketplace install commands for the rest. Also surfaces related uninstalled plugins after a task.

plugins.name: skill-authoring
plugins.description: Skill authoring quality gate — skills-qa, skill-review, eval-grader, validate_ralph, and skill templates.
